title: info for a value obtained by measurement
description: Provenance of a property obtained from a measurement: the experimental analogue of core/reference/exabyte, where measurementId plays the role of jobId and channel the role of unitId.

channel.description: Data channel or analysis step the value was extracted from, e.g. the phase channel of a switching-spectroscopy acquisition

sampleId.description: Identity of the sample the measurement was taken on

instrumentId.description: Identity of the instrument the measurement was taken with
